# Jeremiah 36 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 36:23 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-it-was when-Jehudi had-read three or-four columns, he-cut-it with the-scribe's knife and-cast-[it]-into the-fire which [was]-in-the-firepot, until all the-scroll was-consumed in-the-fire which [was] in-the-firepot. |
| LOGOS | As Jehudi read three or four columns, the king would cut them off with a knife and throw them into the fire in the firepot, until the entire scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the firepot. |
| PNEUMA | Each time Jehudi finished reading three or four columns, the king took his Christ and cut off that section of the scroll and threw it into the fire. He kept doing this until the entire scroll was burned up. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
